entries.note: A proposed inventory is review material, never an executable queue. Check its review state before passes or dependency readiness. External owner workspaces produce host handoffs, not local ready tasks; unstructured external references still require owner-workspace verification. The tool reports facts and cannot authorize another repository or manufacture owner approval.

Validate types before indexing or hashing values so malformed input is rejected cleanly. Boolean IDs are invalid despite being Python integers. A passing feature requires evidence references and passing dependencies; these structural checks do not prove the evidence is genuine or all acceptance criteria have been met. Iterative dependency waves detect cycles without recursion depth dependence.

Approved inventories must reference recorded owner review. This is a structural breadcrumb, not an authentication or authorization mechanism. The surrounding workflow is responsible for the actual owner decision and evidence; neither a file name nor a timestamp is approval.
